summary: LFTD Partners Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary, Lifted Liquids, Inc., entered into a Commercial Offer to Purchase to sell its 11,238 sq ft building in Kenosha, Wisconsin to Ad Real Estate Group LLC for $1,500,000. The buyer will pay $150,000 earnest money. The property, subject to an $852,755 mortgage, is Lifted's principal operations facility. Closing is scheduled on or about September 16, 2026. Net proceeds will repay the mortgage and the company plans to consolidate operations into other leased facilities. The agreement includes customary contingencies and is not contingent on buyer financing.
